# VertexRed

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
VertexRed:Float32 surface:Int32, index:Int32
```

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | Int32 | required | Surface handle. |
| `index` | Int32 | required | Index of the vertex, from 0. |

**Returns:** The red part of the vertex color, 0 to 255, with the fractions that were set.
